decisions.reason: The battery-access constraint affects Power Board mounting and connector accessibility but does not change the three-board architecture.
The client directly requires the battery connector to remain accessible when the Power Board is mounted; the candidate has no existing Event for this connector-access constraint.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: If I connect it in this orientation, I won’t be able to plug in the battery underneath.

value_updates.battery_connection_access: Battery must remain pluggable in the mounted orientation.

decisions.reason: Connector accessibility in the mounted orientation does not alter overcharge, overdischarge, thermal-sensing, or other battery-protection behavior.
The mechanical battery-access constraint does not change the required TVS ESD protection.
Battery connector accessibility does not change ESP32 clocking, sleep policy, or wake sources.
The mounted battery-connection constraint does not affect charge-status indication through the main-board LED chain.
The source changes physical battery-plug accessibility, not the software-switched 5V rail or its operating pattern.
The source imposes a mounting-access constraint and does not change connector sourceability or compatible-alternative policy.
The battery-access issue does not alter I2C cable length, speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
